decisions.evidence: The whole word אֱלֹהֵינוּ is visible after לפניך יי. The hataf segol under alef is clear. Under he there is a tsere, and there may be a small vertical tick next to it, but at this resolution it runs into the nearby vowel dots. I can't confirm a separate meteg stroke.
The word תַּעֲבֹרְנָה is fully visible. A short vertical stroke sits under bet, between the hataf patah under ayin and the sheva under resh. It is separate from the other vowel marks.

The word is visible. There is a clear qamats with a vertical stroke under the opening vav, so the clearest meteg-like mark is on vav, not tsadi. Under tsadi I see segol dots. I can't make out a separate meteg stroke under tsadi.

The word בְּסֵתֶר is visible. Under samekh there is a tsere with a small vertical tick below and slightly left of it, apart from the segol under tav. My confidence is moderate because the tick is small.

The word וְאָעִידָה is fully visible. There is a vertical stroke, but it lines up with alef (next to its qamats), not clearly with ayin. Under ayin I only see the hiriq dot. A meteg is in the word, but it doesn't appear to be on ayin.
